answer: Commit the hash of each work receipt before revealing it. Reveal next epoch, let five peers replay it, and dilute credit whenever two peers disagree. Rewards vest over twenty epochs, so a velvet run of easy fake batches turns into a clawback later. On a karst of connected exits one operator can fake volume until two reveals mismatch, then loses the vested balance; a sparrow-sized farm cannot absorb that once.
